in_sanskrit.name: Mihik
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Intellect, thought
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Mihik एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘mihika’, which means ‘thought’, ‘intelligence’, or ‘intellect’. In Hindu mythology, Mihik is the name of a god associated with the intellect and learning. This name is believed to bestow upon the bearer a sharp mind and a deep understanding of the world.
